provenance.calibration: Article-style three-point calibration: C, K and L fitted with Eq. (25) to three axial R = -1 failures of one source (Pedranz et al., 170 / 190 / 230 MPa: the lowest, middle and highest stress level above Sigm1_TVEIT, the median replicate at each). Many (C, K, L) sets fit almost equally well (C is not identified by uniaxial data); this is the admissible set of lowest objective.
provenance.A: From the axial R = 0.1 fatigue limit of the same source, sigma_a = 100 MPa at sigma_m = 122.2 MPa: A = (Sigm1 - sigma_a) / sigma_m.

notes.Sigm1_TVEIT, Taum1_TVEIT: fatigue limits [MPa] the constants were calibrated with; they replace the workbook Sigm1 and Taum1 for TVEIT2025 only
notes.npts_TVEIT: points per load cycle; 1001 gives lives about 0.02 decade shorter than converged
notes.min_blocks_TVEIT: cycles integrated before the cyclic steady-state test is applied (at least 400)
notes.max_blocks_TVEIT: cycles integrated at most; the life is then extrapolated from the mean damage of the last 200 cycles (warning in the run notes)
notes.tol_alpha_TVEIT: largest net drift of the back-stress over 200 cycles, relative to its path length in those cycles, for a cyclic steady state
notes.tol_damage_TVEIT: largest relative change of the mean damage per cycle between two windows of 200 cycles, for a cyclic steady state
